capabilities.gradient_fills: gradients in rect, circle and bar fills (every board)
capabilities.rgb_pictures: RGB565 pictures, tdui.enable_rgb_pictures() (boards with PSRAM, and the PC)

policy: Within one major api number nothing is removed or changed in meaning: requests, widgets and events keep their numbers, new ones are added at the end and announced by a higher minor number or a capability. Firmware runs every package whose format it lists and whose major api number it has, whichever App Builder version made it. A new major number keeps the old one working for one more major TinyDesk release.
